column1: #Text=Can you describe the content of this map?

#Text=Large-scale map section of Martha's Vineyard Island with a strip of land extending northward between two bodies of water, to the west and especially to the east, where a breakwater runs perpendicular to the coast, providing access to a boat or ferry terminal.
#Text=A road follows the coastline around the headland.
#Text=Five parallel roads connect the two sides.
#Text=A major road continues along the breakwater on the east side of the map to allow cars to board and disembark from the ferry.
#Text=Apart from the tip of the headland, where undeveloped areas meet the ocean, the rest of the map is built up with streets and roads connecting the different neighborhoods.
#Text=A few restaurants and lodging options are indicated, in addition to bicycle and car rentals.
